rejected_edits.content: Qualify each distinct offer only when its own title, specifications, or description provide evidence for every required attribute. Distinguish a product having a feature from merely supporting an accessory or add-on that provides it: a header, connector, or compatibility claim alone does not prove the feature is included. Do not infer a feature from a customizable display, a similar product, or another variant in the same product family; for example, an LCD alone does not establish GIF playback. If evidence is unclear, inspect that offer’s product details and keep it out of the final qualifying set unless the requirement is supported.

## Complete Multi-Shop Purchases

For an end-to-end task with selected offers from different shops, group the chosen items by shop. Add all selected items for one shop to that shop’s cart and complete its checkout; repeat for each other shop. Before navigating away from a shop, verify its order-received confirmation. Complete every required order before navigating to the solution page and submitting the exact selected offer URLs.
